name: Animal Cookies
summary: **Animal Cookies** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:BC Bud Depot]], a Canadian seed company. It is a cross of a [[gsc|GSC]] cut that won Best Hybrid at the 2013 Los Angeles Medical Cannabis Cup and a [[fire-og|Fire OG]] Bx3 male, aimed at adding size and structure to GSC while keeping its flavor. It is treated as its own cultivar rather than a GSC phenotype.
